incidents.summary: Nadia Sawalha's legal representatives sent ITV a pre-action letter alleging discrimination and harassment over her removal from Loose Women because of her protected philosophical beliefs.

sources.title: Nadia Sawalha threatens legal action against ITV over Loose Women removal
sources.quote: A legal organisation representing her has sent a pre-action letter to ITV, claiming the broadcaster "subjected Nadia to direct discrimination, indirect discrimination and harassment because of her protected philosophical beliefs".

positives: ITV's 2030 emissions-reduction targets and its long-term 2050 net-zero ambition received Science Based Targets initiative validation.
ITV reported a 52% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 emissions against its 2019 baseline.
